Theine коротко звучит, когда что-то зако: Theine plays a short sound when something finishes or fails. The volume is the one set for alert sounds. There are no sounds when interface sound effects are turned off in System Settings, Sound
Theine смотрит, нет ли новой версии, при: Theine looks for a new version at launch, every three hours and after the Mac wakes up
Новая версия скачивается и ставится сама: A new version downloads and installs by itself when Theine is idle. With this off, Theine only offers to update
При варианте «Как в системе» Theine берё: With “Same as System”, Theine takes the first suitable language from the list in System Settings, Language & Region. A new language takes effect after a restart
Язык сменится после перезапуска: The language changes after a restart
При входе в систему Theine запускается в: At login Theine starts in the menu bar, to install updates on time
Запуск при входе выключен в Системных на: Opening at login is turned off in System Settings, under Login Items. It can be turned back on only there
Сервер обновлений просит подождать: The update server asks to wait
Установщика новой версии пока нет: No installer for the new version yet
Новая версия подписана иначе: The new version is signed differently
Проверьте интернет и попробуйте ещё раз: Check the internet connection and try again
Слишком много проверок подряд. Попробуйт: Too many checks in a row. Try again in an hour
Новая версия вышла, но её установщик ещё: A new version is out, but its installer isn’t posted yet. Try again later
Скачивание не закончилось. Попробуйте ещ: The download didn’t finish. Try again or get the installer from the download page
Скачанный установщик повреждён или в нём: The downloaded installer is damaged or has no new version of Theine in it. Try again
Новая версия подписана не так, как устан: The new version is signed differently from the installed one and won’t install by itself. Get the installer from the download page and drag Theine to the Applications folder
Не получилось поставить новую версию. От: Couldn’t install the new version. Open the installer and drag Theine to the Applications folder
Новая версия встанет, когда Theine освоб: The new version goes in when Theine is idle or quits
Эта сборка сделана из исходного кода и с: This build is made from the source code and doesn’t update itself
Автоматическая проверка выключена. Прове: Automatic checks are off. Check with this button or with “Check for Updates…” in the menu of the menu bar icon
Theine сам проверяет, вышла ли новая вер: Theine checks for a new version by itself and installs it when it is idle
Theine checks for a new version by itself and offers to install it
Пока Theine включён, экран не тускнеет и: While Theine is on, the display doesn't dim or go dark and the screen saver doesn't start. Without the checkmark the display goes dark as usual and the Mac keeps running
Не засыпать с закрытой крышкой: Stay awake with the lid closed
Пока Theine включён, Mac не засыпает и с: While Theine is on, the Mac stays awake with the lid closed too, on battery and on power. macOS asks for an administrator password once for this. With the lid closed the Mac runs warmer, so don’t put it in a bag
С закрытой крышкой не действует: Doesn’t work with the lid closed
macOS один раз спросит пароль администра: macOS asks for an administrator password once
Пароль администратора не введён, поэтому: No administrator password was entered, so the Mac sleeps when its lid is closed. Everything else works as usual
Чтобы Mac не засыпал с закрытой крышкой,: To keep the Mac awake with the lid closed, macOS will ask for an administrator password once
Theine ставит помощника, чтобы Mac не за: Theine is installing a helper that keeps the Mac awake with the lid closed.
Когда Mac работает от батареи и заряд па: When the Mac runs on battery and the charge falls below 20%, Theine turns itself off. At that charge it will not turn on until the Mac is plugged in
При запуске Theine сразу включается, без: Theine turns itself on at every launch, with no time limit. A mode that was running before a restart comes back without this setting too
Включает и выключает Theine в любом прил: Turns Theine on and off in any app. There is no shortcut by default: ⇧⌘T in the menu works only while the menu is open
Нажмите и введите сочетание с ⌘, ⌃ или ⌥: Click and press a shortcut with ⌘, ⌃ or ⌥. Esc cancels, ⌫ removes the shortcut
